title: Predator balance
question: Does grazing steady a population or eat it down?
intervention: Make a copy of this dish and add five Amoebae to the patch in copy B only. Run both for 180 seconds and compare the Sprinter history.
predictedTradeoff: Amoebae remove Sprinters but also leave more sugar for the survivors. They may steady the population or eat it down.
confounds: After the Amoebae arrive, every encounter can differ between the copies, so one pair is not proof of a general effect. The Amoebae's carbon is logged as an external input.
